notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): MSUI implements the Craft window through its shared profession panel: ProfessionPanelOpenerLaw forks effect-47 openers into TradeSkill vs Craft by EffectMiscValue (exactly the reference law), Program.UiPanelOwnership registers 'BenillaCraftFrame' in the left panel area, and DrawProfessionFrame renders the 384x512 four-quadrant shell with skill name + value/max, an 8-row difficulty-colored recipe list with wheel scroll, product icon/name, reagent grid with have/need counts, tool and spell-focus requirement lines, and Create / Create All / Exit-Cancel buttons with batch casting.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: MSUI deliberately serves TradeSkill and Craft from one shared panel (mixed ClassTrainer/TradeSkill art) rather than twin windows - candidate for a ruling on whether the single-panel look is accepted; the listed element gaps stand regardless.
